answer:
The Guest wifi note now has an app on its App side. It shows a large QR code for joining "Lindgren Guest". Guests scan it with their phone camera to connect, with no password to type.

The network name, password and security type are read from the note's text. If you change the password in the note, the QR code updates itself.

Under the code, the app shows the network name and security type. The password is hidden behind a Show button.

The QR code always has a white background, even in dark mode, because phone cameras can't reliably scan it otherwise. The automatic check flagged that white background and the fact that its test never triggered an edit. I left both as they are. I haven't scanned the code with a phone.
